result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: the cap is mutual, based on 12 months of aggregate paid-or-payable fees rather than transaction-specific fees, and excludes indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct (plus fraud). However, it unnecessarily changes the measurement period from the period preceding the claim to the period preceding the underlying event, which may materially alter the cap. It also retains a duplicated, malformed fragment beginning “10 LIABILITY RELATES,” so the rendered clause is not professionally drafted. The consequential-damages exclusion also remains carved out only for Section 8, rather than using the newly defined Excluded Claims consistently.
